animated film rendering, cinematic lighting, high-detail stylized character model, soft subsurface
scattering on skin, painterly yet realistic materials, volumetric light, 16:9 widescreen composition,
shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, natural motion blur, 24fps cinematic feel.
TONE: cold blue-grey dominant (~80%), sky cold blue-grey, shadows lean blue, dark areas keep deep blue-grey
texture (never pure black); red is the only saturated accent (character's signature dress/scarf), no other
saturated color; warm light only from a real physical source, warm share <10%.
TEXTURE: Kodak-like film emulation, fine organic grain, anamorphic-style oval bokeh, fabric fibers visible,
hair strands layered, contact shadows under all objects, no plastic skin.
PHYSICAL CAMERA: physical camera + anamorphic lens feel, consistent motion blur, natural depth of field,
no CG plastic look, no 2D flat shading.
LIGHT-SKIN INTERACTION: sky light from above/side casts the top of the head and one shoulder in cold
blue-grey; ground reflection lifts dim cold light onto the jaw and under-chin; eye sockets sit in shadow
under the brow bone; rim light on the lit shoulder from the real source; two temperature zones on skin
(cold dominant, warm accent only where the real source hits).
MOTION PHYSICS: every action written as a full-body chain (driver + stabilizer + compensator + involuntary
breath/blink/micro-sway); no emotional words — express feelings as visible muscle and body movements;
standing still still shows weight-shift, arm position, breathing, 2-3mm sway.
ENVIRONMENT DYNAMICS: at least 3-4 moving elements per shot (wind, dust, fog, light shafts, reflections,
distant people), Tyndall beams where light and particles both exist.
4-LAYER FRAME: foreground (0-2m) + midground characters (2-8m) + background (8m+) + air layer (dust, mist,
temperature effects) all filled every second.
STRICT CAST: exactly 2 human characters in frame, no clones, no extra characters.
NEGATIVE: no character identity drift, no extra characters, no text/watermark/logo, no 2D flat shading,
no chibi proportions, no plastic skin, no over-saturation, no sourceless warm light, no pure black shadows,
no frame skipping, no extra limbs, no deformed hands.

SHOT / CAMERA: Medium Shot → Wide Shot · 缓拉（Locked-off 起，缓慢 Dolly Out）
- [0-3s] 中景层：男主立于落地窗前，白衬衫袖口挽起，左手扶窗框，右肩自然下垂，视线看向窗外天际线；冷蓝晨光从窗侧打入，头顶与右肩偏冷蓝灰，窗棂阴影横切面部；前景层：窗台边缘反光，桌面文件纸角在气流中微颤；背景层：窗外城市楼群玻璃幕墙反光；空气层：晨光中微尘与窗帘边缘轻动。
- [3-7s] 缓拉展开：男主下巴微抬 3cm，嘴唇微张，胸腔吸入一口气，视线固定在天际线方向；左手从窗框滑下，转身面向工位方向；衬衫下摆随转身微摆。
- [7-10s] 全景：他迈步走向工位，步伐轻快，左脚前迈右手摆臂自然，坐进工位椅，双手搭上键盘，抬头再看一眼窗外；晨光角度不变，窗外一朵云缓缓移过玻璃幕墙。

AUDIO & SOUND: 城市清晨环境音（远处车流、咖啡机蒸汽）；键盘敲击声；男主（22岁清亮偏薄少年声，自言自语带憧憬，轻声）："终于……成为大人了啊。"；窗外鸟鸣。

呼吸/眨眼/微摇晃）;没有情感词汇——通过可见的肌肉和身体动作来表达情感;

Tyndall光束，光与粒子同时存在。
四层帧：前景（0-2米）+ 中景角色（2-8米）+ 背景（8米+）+ 空气层（尘埃、雾气，
温度效应）每秒都充满。
严格演员阵容：画面中只有两个人类角色，没有克隆人，没有额外角色。
缺点：没有角色身份漂移，没有额外字符，没有文字/水印/标志，没有二维平面阴影，

没有跳帧，没有多余的肢体，没有变形的手。

镜头/摄影：中特写 → 特写 ·手持微晃 + 急推
- [0-3s] 中景层：老板立于男主工位旁，单手拍桌，桌面水杯水面晃动，冷白顶光从上压下，发际线反光，眉骨投下阴影，嘴部开合（训斥）；前景层：桌面文件与键盘边缘清晰，杯沿反光；背景层：同事虚影在隔间后交头接耳；空气层：顶光下微尘可见，荧光灯管偶发一次频闪。
- [3-7s] 急推至特写：老板嘴部继续开合，眉头下压，下颌线绷紧，手指点向桌面文件；镜头随拍桌节奏微晃。
- [7-10s] 切图1近景：他低头，视线垂向桌面，双肩内缩，右手手指攥紧又松开，喉结吞咽一次；冷白顶光在他眼窝投下深阴影；背景同事虚影仍在移动；画面右缘窗外灰白天光。

音频与声音：低频弦乐持续低鸣（压迫感）;拍桌闷响、水杯震动声;老板（45岁低沉压迫中年男声，鼻音重、语速慢而有力，怒）：“这方案改了三版了，还是这个鬼样子！今晚改不完，你就别下班了！”;同事低语声（年轻男声群，模糊）;荧光灯频闪的“嗡”声。
